details:
In worlds where creators want to produce performances involving NPCs, using Unity’s Timeline makes it easy to create complex sequences. However, because NPCs must be children of a Timeline, when creating multiple Timelines, the NPC must be placed as a child of each individual Timeline. This becomes a major obstacle when trying to control an NPC with continuity across multiple sequences.

In particular, for components controlled by PhysBone—such as hair or skirts—even if the NPC is posed identically in two separate Timelines, it is extremely difficult to ensure they remain in the exact same position. As a result, when switching between Timelines, the NPC often exhibits unnatural behavior.

As it is foreseeable that more worlds will focus heavily on cinematic and performance-driven content in the future, Timeline-related functionality should be made accessible for use in UdonSharp to better support advanced world creation workflows in VRChat.
title: Exposed PlayableDirector.Play(UnityEngine.PlayableAsset)is useful for NPC Controll
